title: The Consultancy Invoice Loop

subject.declared_business: Import export consultancy, stated annual turnover under 250,000 GBP
subject.director: Composite individual, UK resident, sole person with significant control on record

onward_movement.pattern: Each incoming payment transferred onward within 48 hours to a single personal account held overseas
onward_movement.destination_note: Overseas jurisdiction with limited public beneficial ownership transparency, receiving account holder is not a signatory on Meridian's business account

supporting_facts: All three sending companies were incorporated within an 11 day window of each other in May 2026
Two of the three sending companies share a registered office address, neither has an independently verifiable trading website
No invoices, contracts or engagement letters were provided when the relationship manager requested them
Meridian's account had no trading history prior to these receipts, despite being open since 2026-06-02
Each payment fell just below the firm's internal 10,000 GBP enhanced review trigger
